best_match.fbbt_definition: Large flat cell of the adult midgut region R3c. It is located posteriorly to the copper cell region.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00110910 'midgut large flat cell', a current FBbt cell term. FBbt has the adult-specific variant FBbt:00110912 'adult midgut large flat cell', which denotes the same cells in the adult; the data are from adult flies, so the adult term is used.
